messages.subject: My error concerning Hilbert
parts:
Bonjour Jérôme,
I'm very sorry, what I found peculiar with the Hilbert function was in
fact my error. I missed out the brackets round the (n/2)!
Playing around at looking for what was happening I found that, without
the brackets, R reads h[2:n/2] as h[(2:n)/2].
My apologies,
Krzysz
